title: Thread-safe token bucket refilling by monotonic elapsed time
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might worry the float balance drifts or that refill uses wall time. The clock is monotonic (injectable for tests), elapsed time is clamped non-negative, and the balance is clamped to [0, capacity] on every operation under one lock.
